findings.body: The change removes the configuration `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` from all environment files (production, profile, cloud66 production). This configuration enables locale fallbacks globally in Rails. Without it, the fallback mechanism may not be activated properly, potentially causing missing translations to not fallback to the default locale as expected. The new initializer `config/initializers/i18n.rb` sets up a custom fallback mechanism, but it is unclear if this fully replaces the previous global fallback behavior or if it is compatible with all parts of the application relying on `config.i18n.fallbacks = true`. This could lead to unexpected missing translations or errors in production or profile environments.
findings.suggestion: Verify that the new custom fallback mechanism in `config/initializers/i18n.rb` fully replaces the removed `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` setting and works correctly in all environments. If not, consider restoring `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` or adapting the new fallback implementation to ensure compatibility.
findings.title: Removed `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` may break locale fallback behavior in production

findings.body: In `app/controllers/application_controller.rb`, the method `set_locale` calls `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` after setting `I18n.locale`. However, the `ensure_loaded!` method is defined on the custom `FallbackLocaleList` class assigned to `I18n.fallbacks` in the initializer. If for any reason `I18n.fallbacks` is not set to this custom class (e.g., in some environments or during early initialization), calling `ensure_loaded!` may raise a NoMethodError. This is a potential robustness issue.
findings.suggestion: Add a guard to check if `I18n.fallbacks` responds to `ensure_loaded!` before calling it, or ensure that `I18n.fallbacks` is always set to the custom fallback class before `set_locale` is called.
findings.title: Potential NoMethodError calling `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` in `set_locale`

findings.body: The new initializer `config/initializers/i18n.rb` defines a custom fallback class `FallbackLocaleList` that returns a fixed fallback order: user locale, site default locale, and English. This is a simplified fallback mechanism and may not cover more complex fallback scenarios (e.g., regional variants, other language fallbacks). This could reduce translation coverage or user experience in some locales.
findings.suggestion: Consider extending the fallback logic to handle more complex locale fallback chains or use the standard I18n fallback mechanism if needed.
findings.title: Custom fallback list may be too simplistic for all locale fallback needs

models.summary: The change replaces the global `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` setting with a custom fallback mechanism defined in a new initializer. This may cause issues with locale fallback behavior in production and profile environments if the new mechanism does not fully replicate the previous behavior. Additionally, there is a potential robustness issue in `ApplicationController#set_locale` when calling `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`. The custom fallback list is simplified and may not cover all fallback scenarios.
